cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says a government contract carries terms on data jurisdiction, portability or exit. CMR-003, of the same month, says the state is still building Zamengoe and no hosted system is named, so the hosting rests on one statement.
cells.note: Camtel, the state operator, said in June 2026 that its Zamengoe data centre keeps government data under local control (CMR-001), so stage 4. No contract with data terms is on file, so not 5.
